about: Known answers for the reviewer agent, from the 21-22 Oct sprint. A bad case is a task the per-task review passed and the R6 bug hunt later traced a bug to (#63, comment of 22 Oct 05:22Z, names each commit); it is caught when a concern names the behaviour in `broke`. A good case is a task never labelled held, with no later fix to its files; it is clean on PASS or minor concerns only. `spec: issue` gives the reviewer the issue with its comments; `spec: body` gives the issue body alone, for an issue whose later comments describe the bug.

cases.broke: Recasting Hliðskjálf's loot sense on a new floor within its duration keeps the old floor recorded, so nothing is sensed on the new floor (reveal.ts).
The learning-stone hint fires on learning_stone_read even when the shard became a rune or the spell went to the spellbook, so it shows the wrong text and is used up (hints.ts).
The coven-fled check runs before the struck-down check, so when the countdown and a blow held at the HP floor land on one action the wrong raid-ending text shows (prologue.ts).
Shop service panels keep focus on the rebuilt Choose button and don't preventDefault Enter or Space, so holding Enter re-runs the offer, skipping its repeat or arming guard (shopDialog.ts).
A buffered arrow step still fires under Look mode or the Close-which-door prompt: the guard covers modals and the map overlay but not those input modes (input-handler.ts).
